title: superman — come off it

phrases.translation: 人与超人（萧伯纳的戏剧）

sentences.sentence: Collor nurtured the idea that he was a superman, who single-handedly could resolve Brazil's crisis.
sentences.translation: 考乐抱有一个想法，即他是可以一手解决巴西危机的超人。

phrases.translation: 环境灾难；生态灾害，生态灾难

sentences.sentence: One hundred and twenty people died in China’s worst air disaster .
sentences.translation: 有120人在中国这起最惨烈的空难事故中丧生。

sentences.sentence: the economic consequences of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster
sentences.translation: 切尔诺贝利核灾难给经济带来的后果

sentences.sentence: The 1987 hurricane was the worst natural disaster to hit England for decades.
sentences.translation: 1987年的飓风是英格兰数十年来遭遇的最为严重的自然灾害。

sentences.sentence: Their expedition nearly ended in disaster , when one of the climbers slid off the mountain.
sentences.translation: 一名登山者从山上滑落，他们的探险活动险些以灾难告终。

sentences.sentence: The drought could spell disaster for wildlife.
sentences.translation: 干旱可能会对野生生物造成灾难。

sentences.sentence: Disaster struckwhen two men were killed during their parachute jumps.
sentences.translation: 灾难突然降临，两名男子在跳伞过程中丧生。

sentences.sentence: The peace process was on the brink of disaster .
sentences.translation: 和平进程到了灾难的边缘。

sentences.sentence: Luckily the pilot saw the other plane just in time, and a disaster was narrowly averted .
sentences.translation: 幸好驾驶员及时看到了另一架飞机，侥幸避免了一场灾难。

sentences.sentence: To Americans,being on one's own suggests that one is a fully independent and functioning part of the whole capable and willing to make choices.
sentences.translation: 译文 对美国人而言，依靠自己的力量就是指这个人作为整体的一部分是完全独立并能起作用的，他有能力也愿意做出选择。

sentences.sentence: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
sentences.translation: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

phrases.translation: n. 寒害，冷害；冷却损伤
雪上加霜；伤害之外又加侮辱

sentences.sentence: She was taken to hospital with serious head injuries.
sentences.translation: 她头部受重伤被送到医院。

sentences.sentence: Beckham has missed several games through injury
sentences.translation: 贝克汉姆因伤错过了几场比赛。

sentences.sentence: He’s a lawyer who specializes in personal injury claims.
sentences.translation: 他是个专门从事人身伤害索赔的律师。

sentences.sentence: The Coast Guard had given up all hope of finding the two divers alive.
sentences.translation: 海岸警卫队已放弃了两名潜水员生还的全部希望。

translations.translation: 使从(受伤)中活下来；渡过难关

sentences.sentence: Everyone was very concerned whether he would pull through or not.
sentences.translation: 每个人都很关心他是否能恢复健康。

sentences.sentence: It is only our determination to fight that has pulled us through.
sentences.translation: 是我们战斗的决心才使我们渡过了难关。

sentences.sentence: Women commit fewer crimes than men.
sentences.translation: 女性犯罪比男性少。

sentences.sentence: We do not get on well together.
sentences.translation: 我们相处得不融洽。

sentences.sentence: He’s never had a sexual relationship before.
sentences.translation: 他以前从未与人有过性关系。

phrases.translation: v. 起作用于；对…有影响

sentences.sentence: He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied.
sentences.translation: 说他撒谎，他非常生气。

sentences.sentence: She reacted very badly (= was very upset ) when her parents split up.
sentences.translation: 父母离婚的时候，她非常难过。

sentences.sentence: You have to react quickly to circumstances.
sentences.translation: 你必须对形势迅速作出反应。

sentences.sentence: David’s parents divorced when he was six.
sentences.translation: 戴维的父母在他六岁时离婚了。

sentences.sentence: My father threatened to divorce her.
sentences.translation: 我父亲威胁说要和她离婚。

sentences.sentence: These changes will involve everyone on the staff.
sentences.translation: 这些变化将影响每一位职员。

sentences.sentence: There have been four accidents involving Forest Service planes.
sentences.translation: 已有四次事故涉及（美国）林务局的飞机。

phrases.translation: 慈善活动；慈善赛；慈善事件
慈善要从家庭做起；仁爱始于家
n. 慈善学校；贫民学校

sentences.sentence: Several charities sent aid to the flood victims.
sentences.translation: 有几家慈善机构已向洪灾灾民送去了救援物资。

phrases.translation: 良好品质，高品质；好质量
生活质量；基本生活条件
表面质量；表面符号；外观要求

sentences.sentence: Much of the land was of poor quality.
sentences.translation: 很多地的土质很差。

sentences.sentence: Use only high quality ingredients.
sentences.translation: 只使用上等的材料。

phrases.translation: 有学习障碍的；无学习能力的

sentences.sentence: a support group for parents of disabled children
sentences.translation: 帮助残障儿童父母的援助团

sentences.sentence: a severely disabled polio patient
sentences.translation: 严重残疾的小儿麻痺症病人

sentences.sentence: teachers who work with learning disabled children (= children who have problems learning )
sentences.translation: 教有学习障碍的儿童的教师

sentences.translation: 菲莉帕虽然有残疾，却很自信。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 7 单元

superman
音标：英 /'suːpəmæn; 'sjuː-/  美 /'supɚmæn/
n. 超人
短语：man and superman — 人与超人（萧伯纳的戏剧）
例句：Collor nurtured the idea that he was a superman, who single-handedly could resolve Brazil's crisis.
考乐抱有一个想法，即他是可以一手解决巴西危机的超人。

disaster
音标：英 /dɪ'zɑːstə/  美 /dɪ'zæstɚ/
n. 灾难
短语：natural disaster — 自然灾难，自然灾害
短语：disaster relief — 赈灾；灾难援助
短语：disaster prevention — 防灾
短语：disaster area — 灾区
短语：earthquake disaster — 地震灾害
短语：disaster recovery — 灾难复原
短语：disaster management — 灾难管理；灾备管理
短语：environmental disaster — 环境灾难；生态灾害，生态灾难
短语：meteorological disaster — 气象灾害
短语：disaster preparedness — 防灾准备状态
短语：recipe for disaster — 造成灾难的因素
短语：social disaster — 社会灾祸
短语：disaster recovery plan — 灾难恢复计划
短语：disaster film — 灾难片
例句：One hundred and twenty people died in China’s worst air disaster .
有120人在中国这起最惨烈的空难事故中丧生。
例句：the economic consequences of the Chernobyl nuclear disaster
切尔诺贝利核灾难给经济带来的后果
例句：The 1987 hurricane was the worst natural disaster to hit England for decades.
1987年的飓风是英格兰数十年来遭遇的最为严重的自然灾害。
例句：Their expedition nearly ended in disaster , when one of the climbers slid off the mountain.
一名登山者从山上滑落，他们的探险活动险些以灾难告终。
例句：The drought could spell disaster for wildlife.
干旱可能会对野生生物造成灾难。
例句：Disaster struckwhen two men were killed during their parachute jumps.
灾难突然降临，两名男子在跳伞过程中丧生。
例句：The peace process was on the brink of disaster .
和平进程到了灾难的边缘。
例句：Luckily the pilot saw the other plane just in time, and a disaster was narrowly averted .
幸好驾驶员及时看到了另一架飞机，侥幸避免了一场灾难。

on one's own
独立地，独自地
例句：To Americans,being on one's own suggests that one is a fully independent and functioning part of the whole capable and willing to make choices.
译文 对美国人而言，依靠自己的力量就是指这个人作为整体的一部分是完全独立并能起作用的，他有能力也愿意做出选择。

promote
音标：英 /prə'məʊt/  美 /prə'mot/
vt. 促进，提升
短语：promote sales — 促销；推销商品
短语：promote reform — 促进改革
短语：promote cooperation — 促进合作
短语：promote the sale — 促销推销
例句：You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

injury
音标：英 /'ɪn(d)ʒ(ə)rɪ/  美 /'ɪndʒəri/
n. 伤害，损害
短语：brain injury — [医]脑损伤
短语：spinal cord injury — 脊髓受伤，脊椎损伤
短语：personal injury — 人身伤害
短语：serious injury — 重伤；严重损害
短语：head injury — 头部伤害
短语：craniocerebral injury — 颅脑损伤
短语：bodily injury — 身体伤害
短语：industrial injury — 工伤；工业损伤
短语：back injury — 背部损伤
短语：physical injury — 人身伤害；物理伤害
短语：injury time — （足球比赛中）伤停补时
短语：internal injury — 内部损伤，内伤
短语：chilling injury — n. 寒害，冷害；冷却损伤
短语：minor injury — 轻伤
短语：cold injury — 冻伤
短语：add insult to injury — 雪上加霜；伤害之外又加侮辱
短语：intentional injury — 故意伤害
短语：skin injury — 皮肤损伤
短语：blast injury — 爆发性损伤；冲击波伤
短语：human injury — 人身事故
例句：She was taken to hospital with serious head injuries.
她头部受重伤被送到医院。
例句：Beckham has missed several games through injury
贝克汉姆因伤错过了几场比赛。
例句：He’s a lawyer who specializes in personal injury claims.
他是个专门从事人身伤害索赔的律师。

give up
放弃
例句：The Coast Guard had given up all hope of finding the two divers alive.
海岸警卫队已放弃了两名潜水员生还的全部希望。

come to do something
开始(认识、理解)

pull through
使从(受伤)中活下来；渡过难关
例句：Everyone was very concerned whether he would pull through or not.
每个人都很关心他是否能恢复健康。
例句：It is only our determination to fight that has pulled us through.
是我们战斗的决心才使我们渡过了难关。

commit
音标：英 /kə'mɪt/  美 /kə'mɪt/
vt. 犯(错误)，干(坏事)
短语：commit oneself — 承诺，答应负责
短语：commit suicide — 自杀
短语：commit a crime — 犯罪；犯下罪行
短语：commit crime — 犯罪；干坏事
短语：commit murder — 谋杀
例句：Women commit fewer crimes than men.
女性犯罪比男性少。

get on
融洽相处；进展
例句：We do not get on well together.
我们相处得不融洽。

relationship
音标：英 /rɪ'leɪʃ(ə)nʃɪp/  美 /rɪ'leʃən'ʃɪp/
n. 关系
短语：relationship management — 关系管理
短语：customer relationship management — 客户关系管理（简写CRM）
短语：cooperative relationship — 合作关系
短语：interpersonal relationship — 人际关系
短语：linear relationship — 线性关系
短语：relationship marketing — n. 关系营销
短语：direct relationship — 直系亲属关系
短语：causal relationship — 因果关系
短语：personal relationship — 个人关系；人际关系
短语：intimate relationship — 亲密的关系
短语：blood relationship — 血统；血缘关系
短语：sexual relationship — 性关系
短语：genetic relationship — 亲缘关系；语系关系
短语：international relationship — 国际关系
短语：public relationship — 公共关系
短语：family relationship — 家庭关系
短语：spatial relationship — 空间关系
短语：symbiotic relationship — 共生关系；共栖关系
短语：inverse relationship — 逆相关；相反关系
短语：geometrical relationship — 几何关系
例句：He’s never had a sexual relationship before.
他以前从未与人有过性关系。

react
音标：英 /rɪ'ækt/  美 /ri'ækt/
vi. 反应；起化学反应
短语：react on — v. 起作用于；对…有影响
短语：react against — 反抗；反对；起反作用
例句：He reacted angrily to the suggestion that he had lied.
说他撒谎，他非常生气。
例句：She reacted very badly (= was very upset ) when her parents split up.
父母离婚的时候，她非常难过。
例句：You have to react quickly to circumstances.
你必须对形势迅速作出反应。

divorce
音标：英 /dɪ'vɔːs/  美 /dɪ'vɔrs/
vi. 离婚
短语：divorce rate — 离婚率
短语：divorce from — 离婚；分离
短语：divorce court — 离婚法庭
例句：David’s parents divorced when he was six.
戴维的父母在他六岁时离婚了。
例句：My father threatened to divorce her.
我父亲威胁说要和她离婚。

involve
音标：英 /ɪn'vɒlv/  美 /ɪn'vɑlv/
vt. 涉及；参与
短语：involve in — 参与；涉及；卷入，陷入
例句：These changes will involve everyone on the staff.
这些变化将影响每一位职员。
例句：There have been four accidents involving Forest Service planes.
已有四次事故涉及（美国）林务局的飞机。

charity
音标：英 /'tʃærɪtɪ/  美 /'tʃærəti/
n. 慈善，施舍
短语：in charity — ◎出于恻隐之心
短语：charity work — 慈善工作
短语：out of charity — 出于仁慈
短语：charity event — 慈善活动；慈善赛；慈善事件
短语：charity begins at home — 慈善要从家庭做起；仁爱始于家
短语：charity sale — 义卖
短语：charity school — n. 慈善学校；贫民学校
例句：Several charities sent aid to the flood victims.
有几家慈善机构已向洪灾灾民送去了救援物资。

quality
音标：英 /ˈkwɒlətɪ/  美 /'kwɑləti/
n. 质量；品质
短语：high quality — 高品质
短语：product quality — 产品质量
短语：quality control — 质量控制，质量管理
短语：quality management — 质量管理
短语：quality first — 质量第一
短语：water quality — 水质
短语：good quality — 良好品质，高品质；好质量
短语：quality assurance — 质量保证；品质保证
短语：quality of life — 生活质量；基本生活条件
短语：quality system — 质量体系；品质系统
短语：quality service — 优质服务
短语：excellent quality — 优良品质；优良质量
短语：best quality — 最佳品质
短语：service quality — 服务质量；功能质量
短语：quality education — 素质教育；优质教育
短语：quality standard — 质量标准
短语：environmental quality — 环境质量；环境品质
短语：reliable quality — 质量可靠
短语：surface quality — 表面质量；表面符号；外观要求
短语：quality inspection — 质量检查
例句：Much of the land was of poor quality.
很多地的土质很差。
例句：Use only high quality ingredients.
只使用上等的材料。

disabled
音标：英 /dɪs'eɪbld/  美 /dɪs'ebld/
adj. 残疾的
短语：disabled people — 残疾人
短语：disabled person — 残废人
短语：learning disabled — 有学习障碍的；无学习能力的
例句：a support group for parents of disabled children
帮助残障儿童父母的援助团
例句：a severely disabled polio patient
严重残疾的小儿麻痺症病人
例句：teachers who work with learning disabled children (= children who have problems learning )
教有学习障碍的儿童的教师

confident
音标：英 /'kɒnfɪd(ə)nt/  美 /'kɑnfɪdənt/
adj. 自信的
短语：confident in — 自信的；确信的
短语：confident of — 确信，相信
例句：Despite her disability, Philippa is very confident.
菲莉帕虽然有残疾，却很自信。

far too
太…，极为…

come off it
别胡扯
